## Status Quo

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(ggfoundry)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)


coffee <-
  read_csv(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cgoo4/ggfoundry/refs/heads/main/data-raw/cappuccino/cappuccino_index.csv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  mutate(country = fct_reorder(country, desc(index)))



{coffee |>
  ggplot() +
  labs(title = "How much work buys a cappuccino?") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  aes(x = index, xend = 0) + 
  labs(x = "Minutes of a barista's wages") +
  labs(subtitle = "The ten countries with the largest café samples") +
  aes(y = country, yend = country) + 
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  geom_segment(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.6) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  geom_casting(shape = "cup", size = 0.135) +
  aes(fill = index) +
  aes(label = index) + 
  geom_text(nudge_x = 2.5, hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  aes(color = I("#493A30")) +
  aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", index)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#EED8B9", high = "#A86135", guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.16))) +
  labs(caption = "Source: James Hoffmann / TidyTuesday, 8 September 2026\nSample-based country index; tips excluded.") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)) + 
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.caption.position = "plot")
  } |>
  codehover::ch_hover()


geom_casting

GeomCasting



df <- shapes_cast() |>
  mutate(x = row_number(),
         .by = set)

df |> head()
df$shape

{df |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = x) + 
  aes(y =  set) +
  geom_text(aes(label = shape), nudge_y = -0.5, colour = "grey40", size = 3) +
  geom_casting(size = 0.11, fill = "skyblue") +
  aes(shape = "bowl0" |> I()) +
  aes(shape = shape |> I()) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.7, 1.6))) +
  labs(caption = "The quill anchors its ink contact to the plotting coordinate") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(colour = "grey70"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )} |>
  codehover::ch_hover()
```
